events.body:
## Outcome

Let each operator decide locally what the node fetches, stores, serves, indexes, rate-limits, quarantines, or removes without creating a network-global deletion mechanism.

## Implementation

- Define a versioned local policy for repository size, visibility, file classes, large objects, artifacts, maintainer scopes, peer and repository allowlists or blocklists, storage quotas, and request rates.
- Evaluate policy before fetch, after object inspection, before advertisement, and before serving.
- Import signed community policy lists only after local approval and retain their source, version, expiry, and scope.
- Add an operator-local report and removal-request inbox with quarantine, unlist, block, purge-local-copy, and dismiss actions.
- Provide dry-run decisions, stable reason codes, bounded audit records, and defaults matching current behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- Policy denial never leaves advertised partial data.
- Rate limits bound storage, CPU, and network work per untrusted peer.
- Community lists never override local policy automatically.
- Reports and removal requests cannot trigger action on another operator's node.
- Policy changes are atomic and explain every affected repository with no secret content in logs.

## Dependencies

Scanner outcomes from #451 feed this policy; no external policy service is required.

## Verification

Run pre-fetch, post-inspection, advertisement, serving, rate-limit, blocklist, community-list, report-inbox, quarantine, and local-purge scenarios against public and private fixtures.
